A Postgres-backed task queue for Go. Postgres is the only dependency; no Redis, no RabbitMQ.
- **Postgres-native operations**: priorities, delayed `run_at`, cancellation, manual retry of dead tasks.
Load tested with [k6](https://k6.io/) against the HTTP API, with task state in Postgres as the source of truth (not HTTP response codes).

- Archives: a decompression bomb (a few KB of .tar.bz2 claiming tens of GB) no longer keeps the preview busy; listing stops after 3 seconds and reading a file after 5, and selecting another file stops the previous read.
- Archives and torrents whose entries claim impossibly large sizes show them instead of failing to open.
- Archives and app packages are read off the main thread.


**Install or update:** `brew install --cask yinon-mitin/tap/quickpeek` (or `brew upgrade --cask quickpeek`), or download the zi
- SQLite databases: tables and views with row counts and the first rows, opened read-only.

- App packages: previews and Finder thumbnails for `.ipa`, `.apk` and `.xcarchive` (icon, version, identifier, minimum OS, permissions, provisioning profile).
- Finder's context menu shows the file's summary; its icons follow the menu's text colour.
- Archives that hold a single folder open with that folder's contents.
- New app icon.
- The shared code ships once, as a framework used by the app and its extensions: the app is under 4 MB.

- Play and host custom rooms with zero login; optional 6-digit email OTP (SMTP / Resend) syncs persistent SQLite (WAL) personal stats and merges guest achievements.
- Extracted `server/handPersistence.ts` (`resolveCompletedHandRecord` / `persistCompletedHandRecord`) matching by exact `handNumber` and upgraded `server/db.ts` `recordHandHistory` to idempotently upsert `(room_id, hand_number)` (also syncing post-showdown `reveal_cards`), verified with a 4-consecutive-hand SQLite regression test.

### Fixes

- Fixed the library status filter, sort order, and page-size selectors displaying raw internal values (`all`, `recent`, `24`) instead of localized labels before the dropdown is opened. (#1114)

### Engineering

- Deployed the website directly with `cf deploy ./dist` and upgraded Wrangler to 4.165.0. (#1113)

- SQLite uses `synchronous = NORMAL` and a busy timeout, runs `VACUUM` in the background after startup, and drops an obsolete index that slowed reading-progress writes. (#1097)
- Assistant sessions no longer skip a message after the app exits mid-delivery, and retracting a comment in one discussion no longer affects another. Reader Q&A syncs across windows without overwriting newer replies, and database restore stops active assistant and reading-memory work first. (#1092, #1093, #1099)
- Upgraded Effect to

- Added an animated first-launch introduction with music, redesigned file import, and refreshed feedback sounds. Reader opening, book deletion, AI results, and top-center notifications now show the progress of the action. (#1031, #1056, #1062–#1068)

### Features

- Added the Blue Ink light theme, with cool white paper, fountain-pen blue, and pencil-drawn frames and rules across the library, settings, stats, Reading Memory, assistants, dialogs, and reader UI. Book content is left undecorated. (#1007)
- Redesigned the first-launch screen with a language switch and an example of a highlight, a thought, and an assistant reply. It explains that reading works without AI, and its import entries now cover AZW3 and MOBI. (#1006)
- Switching a card between annot

### Fixes

- Upgraded Electron to 44.9.2 so the app no longer trusts the eMudhra intermediate certificate authorities whose private keys were compromised. Attackers holding those keys can no longer impersonate HTTPS services the app connects to, such as AI providers, WeRead sync, and the Windows update feed. (#976)

### Features

- Assistants now keep a conversation memory for each document, so thread replies, highlight thoughts, and Reader Q&A build on earlier exchanges. They look up the outline, chapters, full-text search, Reading Memory, and discussion threads as needed. In EPUBs, a highlight opens its whole chapter, and questions without a selection stop at reading progress. (#971)
- Assistant replies keep running after a window closes and resume after restart, and assistants mentioned together reply in parallel. T

### Fixes

- Fixed EPUB annotation jumps during book opening, repeated-text anchors, and selections across line breaks; ignored PDF selection text that arrives after the selection changes. (#950, #951, #962)
- Prevented duplicate annotations from repeated save actions and kept translation annotations when retranslation fails before starting. (#956, #967)
- Fixed custom Anthropic proxy URLs and treated interrupted AI streams as failures; deep-to-fast fallback now discards the incomplete deep reply. (#952, #9

- Back up your data before upgrading. This release migrates the database to reader level 4; v0.16.2 and earlier cannot open it afterward. To downgrade, restore a compatible backup made before upgrading. (#938)
- Added complete backup and restore for the database, original ebooks and PDFs, and PDF thumbnails. Backups exclude API keys; restores verify file checksums and keep a safety backup. (#913)

### Features

- Added ShadLingo light and dark themes with pure white and deep blue reading paper. (#903)
- Added compact library and reader samples to theme and paper choices, so you can compare appearances before selecting. (#904)

### Fixes

- Fixed PDF engine loading in a Worker by resolving the WASM URL before loading, and restored the document loading indicator. (#903)
- Fixed light/dark category switching to restore the remembered reading paper instead of replacing it with the theme default. (#904)
